#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define fastio ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0)
typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;
const ld pi = 3.141592654;
const ll N = 1000500;
const ll mod = 1000000007;
using namespace std;

ll repe[N];
ll used[N];
ll mult[N];

ll compute_cycle_length(ll start, ll k, ll n){
	ll count = 0;
	while(true){
		if(used[start]) break;
		used[start] = true;
		start = (start * k) % n;
		count++;
	}
	return count;
}

ll fast_power(ll base, ll exponent){
	if(exponent == 0) return 1;
	ll half = fast_power(base, exponent / 2);
	if(exponent % 2 == 0) return (half * half) % mod;
	else return (base * ((half * half) % mod)) % mod;
}

int main(){
	fastio;
	ll n, k;
	cin >> n >> k;

	if(k == 0){
		cout << fast_power(n, n - 1) << "\n";
		return 0;
	}

	for(ll i = 0; i < n; i++){
		if(!used[i]) {
			ll cycle_len = compute_cycle_length(i, k, n);
			repe[cycle_len]++;
		}
	}

	for(ll i = 1; i <= n; i++){
		for(ll j = i; j <= n; j += i){
			if(repe[j] != 0) mult[j] += repe[i] * i;
		}
	}

	ll answer = 1;
	for(ll i = 1; i <= n; i++){
		if(mult[i] != 0) answer = (answer * fast_power(mult[i], repe[i])) % mod;
	}

	cout << answer << "\n";
	return 0;
}
